capture_kind: Android Bluetooth HCI btsnoop, ErgData on the phone, PM5 RowErg
redaction: Only connections to the PM5 are kept. No Bluetooth address and no other device. Times are seconds from the start of each PM5 connection. The 4-octet heart-rate belt ID in GET_EXTENDED_HRBELT_INFO responses, SET_EXTENDED_HRM requests and record 0x3B is zeroed (checksums recomputed). Real-time-clock values the PM5 itself sends (log-entry date/time, the date response) are kept as transmitted, as the existing fixture already does.
evidence_limit: One PM5 RowErg (serial in the extends file), one phone, ErgData. The log holds fixed-distance and fixed-time workout setups; it holds no fixed-calorie setup, no interval setup and no SkiErg or BikeErg. The proprietary file-transfer exchange on the CSAFE characteristic (one session) and the race-mode extended frames are recorded as octets only. Records 0x37-0x3C are whole frames without decoded fields: the log alone does not fix their field semantics. Sampled vectors are evenly spaced, not exhaustive.
